svg.title: Impact, by the numbers
svg.desc: 600+ REST endpoints shipped to a production parking SaaS, across bookings, refunds and vendor payouts (GoParkEasy · parking SaaS); 57 MongoDB collections, 6 user roles (GoParkEasy · data model); <100ms voice-agent replies on top intents (Voice AI · Retell); +35% ATS match score uplift, results in <5s (FixMyResume · Gemini + NLP); 85% classification accuracy on live traffic (BikeWatch · YOLOv5); 12 business verticals on one voice agent (AI Receptionist · SaaS)

g.text: SOURCES: GOPARKEASY · AI RECEPTIONIST · FIXMYRESUME · INFOSYS
